{{Term/Store|Stone Talus (Rare)|Stone Taluses (Rare)|Series, BotW|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="TotK Hyrule Compendium"/> also known as '''Rare Stone Taluses''',{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref name="TotK Game Screen"/> and simply as {{Term/Store|Stone Talus|Stone Taluses|AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|AoC}}<ref name="AoC Game Screen"/> are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Sub-Boss]]es in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Stone Talus (Rare)}}
Stone Taluses (Rare) are a variation of [[Stone Talus]]es found primarily around [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. The main difference between them is the [[Ore Deposit]] on their body, which has been replaced by a [[Rare Ore Deposit]]. As a result of this, they tend to drop rarer loot than other Taluses.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> Stone Taluses (Rare) disguise themselves as natural rock formations, but if [[Link]] approaches them, they will begin to move and attack him.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> The only way to damage them is to attack the Rare Ore Deposit on their body, which are particularly vulnerable to [[Iron Sledgehammer]]s, as well as other mining tools and [[Bomb Arrow]]s.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/>

After defeating [[Calamity Ganon]], Link is able to ask [[Kilton]] about Stone Taluses.<ref name="BotW Kilton"/> When he does so, Kilton reveals that he has been unable to approach them due to the giant size, so he requests that Link kill every Stone Talus in [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]] and allow him to analyze the scents they leave behind.<ref name="BotW Kilton 2"/> This figure includes every Stone Talus (Rare) as well. Should Link accomplish this task, Kilton will reward him with the [[Medal of Honor: Talus]].<ref name="BotW Kilton 3"/> Kilton's research allows him to learn more about the diet and musculoskeletal structures of Stone Taluses.<ref name="BotW Kilton 4"/>
